name: unsafe fn grow (& self , ptr : NonNull < u8 > , old_layout : Layout , new_layout : Layout ,) -> Result < NonNull < [u8] > , AllocError >
rule: If grow returns Ok, the caller must not access the memory through the old ptr, even if the allocation was grown in place; only the newly returned pointer is valid for accessing that memory.
api: trait Allocator  : { unsafe fn grow (& self , ptr : core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < u8 > , old_layout : core::alloc::layout::Layout , new_layout : core::alloc::layout::Layout ,) -> core::result::Result < core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < [u8] > , core::alloc::AllocError > }
